ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce SimpleHelp RMM exploitation pivot to AnyDesk + recon (CVE-2024-57727 chain)
ucs.description: Hunts DragonForce's signature MSP supply-chain pattern: post-exploitation of vulnerable SimpleHelp servers (CVE-2024-57727/57728/57726) where the legitimate SimpleHelp Remote Access service (SimpleService.exe / Remote Access.exe) spawns reconnaissance binaries, deploys AnyDesk for redundant access, and stages tooling — observed in the Reliaquest/Sophos-tracked DragonForce MSP intrusions of 2024–2025 prior to LockBit Black/Conti-builder ransomware deployment.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as children values(Processes.process_path) as child_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Remote Access.exe","SimpleService.exe","SimpleGatewayRelay.exe") OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\SimpleHelp\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","AnyDesk.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where count >= 2 | sort 0 - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmParents = dynamic(["remote access.exe","simpleservice.exe","simplegatewayrelay.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe"]);
let ReconChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","anydesk.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RmmParents)
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\SimpleHelp\"
| where FileName in~ (ReconChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspectScore = iff(FileName =~ "anydesk.exe", 3, 1)
         + iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--install","--with-password","--set-password","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","IEX"), 2, 0)
         + iff(FileName in~ ("net.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any (" group "," /domain","/dclist","localgroup administrators"), 2, 0)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            ChildBinaries = make_set(FileName, 16),
            SampleCmds   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            TotalScore   = sum(SuspectScore),
            Events       = count()
         by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where TotalScore >= 4 or Events >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmParents = dynamic(["remote access.exe","simpleservice.exe","simplegatewayrelay.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe"]);
let ReconChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","wmic.exe","anydesk.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    @"\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in (RmmParents) or ParentProcessName has @"\SimpleHelp\"
| where ChildBase in (ReconChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspectScore = iff(ChildBase == "anydesk.exe", 3, 1)
         + iff(CommandLine has_any ("--install","--with-password","--set-password","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","IEX"), 2, 0)
         + iff(ChildBase in ("net.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe") and CommandLine has_any (" group "," /domain","/dclist","localgroup administrators"), 2, 0)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            ChildBinaries = make_set(ChildBase, 16),
            SampleCmds    = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            TotalScore    = sum(SuspectScore),
            Events        = count()
         by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentBase
| where TotalScore >= 4 or Events >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\Remote\ Access.exe OR *\remote\ access.exe OR *\SimpleService.exe OR *\simpleservice.exe OR *\SimpleGatewayRelay.exe) OR @ParentImage:*\SimpleHelp\*) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\nltest.exe OR *\whoami.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(remote access\.exe|simpleservice\.exe|simplegatewayrelay\.exe|simplehelpcustomer\.exe)$/i OR ParentImageFileName=/\\SimpleHelp\\/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|net1?|nltest|whoami|quser|tasklist|wmic|anydesk|curl|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=Events), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true, separator=" | ")])
| Events >= 2
| sort(Events, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: SimpleHelp exploitation became DragonForce's hallmark initial access in late-2024/2025, including the high-profile Reliaquest-documented MSP intrusion that pivoted to downstream customer environments. ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce pre-encryption staging — shadow copy wipe + Defender tamper + service stop burst
ucs.description: Detects DragonForce's tight pre-ransom sequence inherited from its LockBit Black and Conti leaked-builder lineage: vssadmin/wbadmin shadow deletion, bcdedit recovery suppression, mass `sc stop` / `net stop` of SQL/Veeam/backup services, and Defender disablement via Set-MpPreference or registry — all within minutes on the same host, often launched from PsExec or the dropped encryptor binary. This compressed sequence is the actor's last reliable choke point before file encryption.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","reg.exe","taskkill.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*delete shadows*","*shadowcopy delete*","*delete catalog*","*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*","*recoveryenabled no*","*safeboot*","*Set-MpPreference*-Disable*","*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*","*MpPreference*","*stop * veeam*","*stop * sql*","*stop * backup*","*stop * sophos*","*stop * mssql*","*stop * vss*","*HKLM*Defender*DisableAntiSpyware*"))) by host _time span=10m | eval categories=mvappend( if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|delete catalog"),"vss",null()), if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)bootstatuspolicy|recoveryenabled|safeboot"),"bcdedit",null()), if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)Set-MpPreference|DisableRealtimeMonitoring|DisableAntiSpyware"),"defender",null()), if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)stop .*(veeam|sql|backup|sophos|mssql|vss)"),"svcstop",null())) | eval cat_count=mvcount(categories) | where cat_count >= 2 | sort 0 - _time
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Cat = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"), "vss",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"), "vss",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog", "vss",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","recoveryenabled no","safeboot"), "bcdedit",
    FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableIOAVProtection","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","MpPreference -Disable"), "defender",
    FileName =~ "reg.exe"       and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Defender","DisableAntiSpyware"), "defender",
    FileName in~ ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop|delete|/IM)\s+\S*(veeam|sql|mssql|backup|sophos|vss|memtas|svc\$)\S*", "svcstop",
    "")
| where Cat != ""
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Categories = make_set(Cat),
            Commands   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            Initiators = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 6),
            Events     = count()
         by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| extend CatCount = array_length(Categories)
| where CatCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

    BinBase in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableIOAVProtection","DisableBehaviorMonitoring","MpPreference -Disable"), "defender",
    BinBase == "reg.exe"       and CommandLine has_all ("Defender","DisableAntiSpyware"), "defender",
    BinBase in ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe") and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop|delete|/IM)\s+\S*(veeam|sql|mssql|backup|sophos|vss|memtas|svc\$)\S*", "svcstop",
    "")
| where Cat != ""
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Categories = make_set(Cat),
            Commands   = make_set(CommandLine, 20),

            Events     = count()
         by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*) OR (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *safeboot*)) OR (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*Set-MpPreference* OR *DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *DisableBehaviorMonitoring*)) OR (@Image:(*\sc.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\taskkill.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*veeam* OR *Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *mssql* OR *MSSQL* OR *sophos* OR *Sophos*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no|safeboot)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(Set-MpPreference|DisableRealtimeMonitoring|DisableBehaviorMonitoring|DisableIOAVProtection)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/Defender.*DisableAntiSpyware/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(sc|net1?|taskkill)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(veeam|mssql|sqlserver|backup|sophos|memtas|vss)/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(as=Events), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true, separator=" | "), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| Events >= 2
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: DragonForce's encryptor lineage (LockBit Black builder + leaked Conti source) inherits a very compressed pre-encryption routine that bundles shadow deletion, recovery suppression, Defender tamper and backup-service stops into the same minute on the same host — Sophos X-Ops, Cisco Talos and Group-IB intrusion reports show this as a near-invariant stage of every DragonForce engagement.
